QuestInfo.name: The 5 Paths
QuestInfo.0: Mai wants to tell you about the 5 different paths an Explorer can take. Ask Mai what they are.
QuestInfo.1: You've learned that Explorers can become one of 5 types of adventurer: mighty Warriors, wise Magicians, accurate Bowmen, stealthy Thieves, and flashy Pirates. Which will you choose?
